mapper.sql: ast.*, CASE WHEN ast.booked_count >= ast.capacity THEN 'FULL' ELSE ast.status END AS status, ast.capacity - ast.booked_count AS remaining, p.name AS service_name
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM appointment_slots AS ast INNER JOIN products AS p ON p.id = ast.service_id INNER JOIN shops AS sh ON sh.id = ast.shop_id AND sh.archived_at IS NULL INNER JOIN users AS owner ON owner.id = sh.owner_id AND owner.status = 'normal' WHERE ast.service_id = #{serviceId} AND ast.slot_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND ast.status = 'OPEN' AND ast.day_status = 'OPEN' AND p.status = 'on' AND p.product_type = 'service' AND sh.status = 'open' AND TIMESTAMP(ast.slot_date, ast.end_time) > NOW() ORDER BY ast.slot_date, ast.start_time
SELECT ast.*, ast.capacity - ast.booked_count AS remaining, p.name AS service_name FROM appointment_slots AS ast INNER JOIN products AS p ON p.id = ast.service_id WHERE ast.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_slots SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND booked_count < capacity
UPDATE appointment_slots SET booked_count = GREATEST(booked_count - 1, 0), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE appointment_slots SET status = 'CLOSED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND booked_count = 0
